summary: Frontend regression sweep post-CSS/rounded-UI + Controls-active fix. Primary bug (Controls white-on-white) is FIXED: Controls button computed backgroundColor = rgb(36,88,229) with white text when drawer open, and light bg rgb(255,255,255,.9) with dark text rgb(64,80,106) when closed. Drawer inert + pointer-events:none verified when closed (command-input un-focusable). Toggle/close/marker/rank-row selection all work. All 9 routes load without white-on-white contrast issues (programmatic bg/color scan). Core flows verified: Intake run-extraction, Factories search + open card, Interventions card + adoption-slider + record-estimate (toast 'Estimate LP-... recorded' seen), Ledger export-ledger + advance -> confirm-status-advance, Alerts generate-digest + open inbox item. Navbar center-capsule 7 links all present & navigable. Mobile hamburger at 430px opens nav-dropdown with 7 menu-nav-* items. Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings STILL present (4 occurrences) despite minHeight={180} — low priority per request.

integration_issues.issue: confirm-extraction button not immediately clickable after run-extraction; likely requires longer wait for simulated extraction to complete before button renders. Not blocking — testing loop simply moved on.

action_items: (Low priority) Recharts still logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on Factory Detail and Ledger charts. minHeight=180 was added but container still measures -1 briefly on mount. Consider setting explicit height on the parent .chart wrapper (e.g. height: 240px) or debouncing initial measure.
(Optional) Intake confirm-extraction may benefit from a visible loading state or immediate render for smoother test coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Controls active-state fix correctly targets .app-shell.is-map .nav-controls.active — computed bg confirmed rgb(36,88,229).
Drawer inert attribute (inert={!panelOpen || undefined}) plus CSS pointer-events works as expected — closed drawer inner controls are not focusable.
No white-on-white or invisible-text regressions detected across all 9 routes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on primary bug + all core flows

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 confirmed the Controls active-state fix and drawer-inert behavior. Only lingering item is the low-priority Recharts width/height(-1) warnings; visually charts still render fine on Factory Detail, Intervention Detail, and Ledger.
rca of the issue: Prior white-on-white was a CSS specificity issue where .nav-controls.active did not override the base transparent/white style on the map shell. Fix in /app/frontend/src/styles-nav.css scopes an explicit blue background under .app-shell.is-map .nav-controls.active — verified via getComputedStyle.
